top_choice_rationale: P001 rests on a quantitative prediction (the Bistritzer-MacDonald magic-angle flat-band condition) followed by the observation of correlated insulating and superconducting states at that angle, widely reproduced and opening a new platform where one geometric parameter tunes bandwidth against interaction. The citation can be limited to the flat bands and the observed phases without a claim on the pairing mechanism, and the three names split naturally into prediction and demonstration. Reservations on maturity, disorder and uncredited precursors affect wording more than merit. P002 is the mature, cleanly credited fallback; P003 is established physics but has a weaker credit allocation, no demonstrated simulation advantage and overlaps the 2001 and 2012 prizes; no award is the least preferred since several candidates are clearly prize-worthy.
